      - name: Save PR number

          mkdir -p ./pr

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7

          name: pr_number
          path: pr/

    name: mpy-cross

      uses: actions/checkout@v7

        submodules: true
    - name: Build mpy-cross
      run: make $MAKEOPTS -C micropython/mpy-cross
    - name: Upload mpy-cross

        name: mpy-cross
        path: micropython/mpy-cross/build/mpy-cross

  unix_coverage:
    name: unix coverage
    needs: mpy_cross
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

      PYBRICKS_NO_REDIRECT_STDOUT: 1
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repo
      uses: actions/checkout@v7
      with:
        submodules: true
    - name: Download mpy-cross
      uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
      with:
        name: mpy-cross
        path: micropython/mpy-cross/build
    - name: Fix file permission
      run: chmod +x micropython/mpy-cross/build/mpy-cross
    - name: Build
      run: |
        cd micropython
        make ${MAKEOPTS} -C ports/unix VARIANT=coverage submodules
        make ${MAKEOPTS} -C ports/unix VARIANT=coverage deplibs
        make ${MAKEOPTS} -C ports/unix VARIANT=coverage
    - name: Test
      if: ${{ success() }}
      run: |
        ulimit -n 1024 # needed for micropython/tests/extmod/select_poll_fd.py
        cd micropython
        make -C ports/unix VARIANT=coverage test_full -j
        (cd tests && MICROPY_CPYTHON3=python3 MICROPY_MICROPYTHON=../ports/unix/build-coverage/micropython ./run-multitests.py multi_net/*.py)
    - name: List failed tests
      if: failure()
      run: micropython/tests/run-tests.py --print-failures

        - gcc-arm-none-eabi libnewlib-arm-none-eabi libstdc++-arm-none-eabi-newlib
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repo
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

      timeout-minutes: 10
      uses: ./.github/actions/apt-install
      with:
        packages: ${{ matrix.packages }}
        no-install-recommends: 'true'
        warm-cache-only: 'true'

  firmware:
    name: firmware

      # off master, one broken commit means the branch has to be fixed up, so

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
